subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The tree was not famous like a statue, but it had watched generations pass.”?
options: A living landmark can be harder to protect than stone, yet it may mean just as much to a community.
The reef was small in the tank, but it showed a large idea: protecting one habitat can protect many lives at once.
When a tree becomes a point on a map with a name and history, it is harder to treat it as invisible.
It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.
